name: atom-ai
description: Native, Claude-first AI for Atom++ — chat with your code, no middle-man backend.

enumDescriptions: Anthropic Claude (bring your own API key)
atompp.ai.provider.description: Which AI provider the chat uses.

atompp.ai.includeActiveFile.description: Automatically send the currently open file to the AI as context with each chat message.

atompp.ai.chat.autoContext.description: Automatically find and include workspace files relevant to your chat question (via filename + symbol search).

atompp.ai.chat.autoContextMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of files auto-included as context per chat message.

atompp.ai.chat.scopeToActiveProject.description: Limit auto-context search to the active file's top-level sub-folder, so unrelated sibling projects in the same workspace don't pollute results.

atompp.ai.chat.workspaceMap.description: Include a list of all project file paths with each chat message, so the AI knows the repo structure. Uses more tokens.

atompp.cloud.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of your Atom++ Cloud account server (for sign-in + settings/skills sync). Leave empty until the backend exists (roadmap M9). **Your AI provider keys never go to this server — AI requests stay direct from your machine to your provider.**

atompp.ai.commandTimeout.description: Backstop timeout in milliseconds before an approved shell command is force-killed (its whole process group). The Stop button on the terminal card is the primary control; set 0 to disable the backstop so long-running servers run until you stop them.

atompp.ai.contextWindow.description: The model's context window in tokens, used for the in-chat context-usage meter and warning. Claude 4 models are 200000; raise to 1000000 if you've enabled the 1M-token context beta.

atompp.ai.debug.description: Print detailed debug logs (every agent/chat action) inline in the chat, prefixed with 🐛 DEBUG. For diagnosing agent/chat issues.

atompp.ai.agent.maxSteps.description: Maximum tool-use steps the AI agent may take for one goal before stopping.

atompp.ai.skills.enabled.description: Let the agent self-select bundled skills (expert playbooks) for matching tasks like code review, bug fixes, and test writing. Each skill is a SKILL.md the agent loads on demand.

atompp.ai.verify.enabled.description: After the agent finishes editing, automatically verify its work — pull editor diagnostics (type/lint errors) for the files it changed and, if a verify command is set, run it — then feed any failures back so the agent self-corrects until clean (bounded by atompp.ai.verify.maxRounds).

atompp.ai.verify.command.markdownDescription: Optional one-shot command run to verify the agent's edits (e.g. `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run lint`). It MUST exit on its own — do **not** use a dev server or watch command (those block; the `commandTimeout` backstop force-kills them). Leave empty to verify with editor diagnostics only.

atompp.ai.verify.maxRounds.description: How many times the agent may be sent back to fix failing verification before it stops and hands the remaining problems to you. 0 = report-only (verification still runs and is shown, but the agent won't auto-retry).

atompp.ai.verify.includeWarnings.description: Treat editor warnings (not just errors) as verification failures the agent must fix. Off by default — only errors block.

atompp.ai.completions.enabled.description: Show inline AI code completions (ghost text) as you type. Accept with Tab.

atompp.ai.completions.model.description: Claude model used for inline completions. A fast model is recommended for low latency.

atompp.ai.completions.debounce.description: Idle time in milliseconds before requesting an inline completion (lower = snappier but more requests).

atompp.ai.claude.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in a Claude response.

atompp.ai.ollama.url.description: Base URL of your local Ollama server.

atompp.ai.ollama.model.description: Ollama model name (must be pulled locally, e.g. `ollama pull llama3.1`).
